sourceFile: 68. TIU L5S3-01 Result separate AWF check function and Drop test find NG coil separate - 2026.02.09_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies a likely coil-forming temperature comparison but misgroups AWF rounds/blank-note rows and mixes AWF and drop-test outcomes incompletely.
issues: Changed condition incorrectly includes AWF rounds and Total as conditions.
Blank-note rows #3/#4/#5 may not belong to 500°C without merged-cell proof.
Outcome only judges drop test worse while AWF BAKO/HEARING results are separate and partly improved.
Subgroup keys are raw numeric values, not meaningful grouping keys.
Evidence includes rows beyond shown context and possible non-data total rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Do blank Note rows after 500°C inherit the 500°C condition?
Are AWF #1-#5 repeated trials under the same temperature comparison or separate settings?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to coil forming temperature 480°C normal vs 500°C change only.
Keep AWF number, date, line, and test domain as subgroup/context keys.
Separate AWF function defect outcomes from drop/decap drop-test outcomes under the same factor.
Use only data rows with proven condition membership and exclude totals unless summarized separately.
Replace numeric subgroup keys with named keys and cite headers plus each compared data row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are not yet sufficient; condition inheritance and compared outcome rows need clearer support.
